description: Use this when an online seller or e-commerce/Amazon business asks whether they must collect sales tax in a state (economic nexus). Given annual sales, transaction count, and states, flags where economic nexus is likely met and explains the physical-nexus (FBA inventory) trap.

annual_sales_usd.description: Your total sales into the state(s) in the current or prior calendar year.

states.description: US states to check, as 2-letter codes (e.g. ["CA","TX","NY"]). If omitted, the tool explains the general rule.

transaction_count.description: Approximate number of separate sales transactions into the state(s). Some states count transactions as well as dollars.
